Twenty-Eight
The Dining Room
Twenty-eight days. That is how long
it takes for good beef to become
great: still, cold, quiet, patient.
We don’t rush the beef, so we never rush you. Every steak we
serve has waited for this moment, and so has your table.
Every steak lists its age.
Patience
Good things take time, in the ageing
room and at the table.
Craft
Every cut is aged, trimmed and
seared by hand.
Honesty
The menu tells you how many days
each steak has aged. Nothing is
hidden.
Gathering
A long wait deserves a long dinner.
Guests are never hurried.
